headword: {登場|とうじょう}{人物|じんぶつ}
gloss: character (in a story); cast of characters

definitions.gloss: character; dramatis personae; cast of characters
definitions.explanation: A person who appears in a novel, play, film, manga, or other narrative work. Used both for fictional characters and for real people featured in a documentary or biographical work.

examples.japanese: {登場|とうじょう}{人物|じんぶつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{多|おお}すぎる。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{小説|しょうせつ}→小説：01434_shousetsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{登場|とうじょう}{人物|じんぶつ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦みんな→みんな：02972_minna⟧⟦{個性的|こせいてき}→個性的：14922_koseiteki⟧だ。
examples.english: All the characters in this novel have distinctive personalities.

examples.japanese: ⟦{映画|えいが}→映画：02273_eiga⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{登場|とうじょう}{人物|じんぶつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{主人公|しゅじんこう}→主人公：11404_shujinkou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{友人|ゆうじん}→友人：03649_yuujin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{一番|いちばん}→一番：01140_ichiban⟧⟦{好|す}き→好き：02355_suki⟧だ。
examples.english: Among the characters in the movie, I like the protagonist's friend the most.

notes:
USAGE:
A standard term used in literary criticism, film reviews, and everyday conversation about stories. Often shortened informally to ⟦キャラ→キャラ：08916_kyara⟧ (character) in casual speech about manga and anime.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {登場|とうじょう}{人物|じんぶつ}⟦{紹介|しょうかい}→紹介：01432_shoukai⟧ (character introduction)
- ⟦{主|おも}な→主な：21018_omona⟧{登場|とうじょう}{人物|じんぶつ} (main characters)
- {登場|とうじょう}{人物|じんぶつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧ (to have many characters)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦キャラクター→キャラクター：23518_kyarakutaa⟧: character — loanword, often used in games, anime, and manga
- ⟦{主人公|しゅじんこう}→主人公：11404_shujinkou⟧: protagonist — the main character specifically
